<?php

namespace PdfGen\Service;

use PdfGen\RateLimit\TokenBucket;
use PdfGen\Storage\TempFileManager;

class PdfGeneratorService
{
    private TokenBucket $rateLimiter;
    private TempFileManager $fileManager;
    private string $templateDir;
    private array $retryState = [];
    private int $maxRetries = 3;

    public function __construct(string $templateDir, string $storageDir)
    {
        $this->rateLimiter = new TokenBucket(10, 60);
        $this->fileManager = new TempFileManager($storageDir);
        $this->templateDir = rtrim($templateDir, '/');
    }

    public function generateFromTemplate(string $templateName, array $data, string $outputFormat = 'pdf'): array
    {
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->consume()) {
            return ['error' => 'Rate limit exceeded', 'retry_after' => $this->rateLimiter->getRetryAfter()];
        }

        $sanitizedTemplate = $this->sanitizeTemplateName($templateName);
        $templatePath = $this->resolveTemplatePath($sanitizedTemplate);

        if (!$templatePath) {
            return ['error' => 'Template not found'];
        }

        return $this->executeWithRetry(function () use ($templatePath, $data, $outputFormat) {
            return $this->renderPdf($templatePath, $data, $outputFormat);
        });
    }

    public function uploadCustomTemplate(string $filename, string $content, string $mimeType): array
    {
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->consume()) {
            return ['error' => 'Rate limit exceeded', 'retry_after' => $this->rateLimiter->getRetryAfter()];
        }

        $validation = $this->validateUpload($filename, $content, $mimeType);
        if ($validation !== true) {
            return ['error' => $validation];
        }

        $safeFilename = $this->buildSafeFilename($filename);
        $destination = $this->fileManager->allocate($safeFilename);

        return $this->executeWithRetry(function () use ($destination, $content, $filename) {
            return $this->persistTemplate($destination, $content, $filename);
        });
    }

    private function sanitizeTemplateName(string $name): string
    {
        $name = str_replace(['..', '/', '\\'], '', $name);
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]/', '', $name);
    }

    private function resolveTemplatePath(string $name): ?string
    {
        $path = $this->templateDir . '/' . $name;
        if (file_exists($path) && str_starts_with(realpath($path), realpath($this->templateDir))) {
            return $path;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function validateUpload(string $filename, string $content, string $mimeType): bool|string
    {
        $allowedMimes = ['application/pdf', 'text/html', 'application/xhtml+xml'];
        if (!in_array($mimeType, $allowedMimes, true)) {
            return 'Invalid MIME type';
        }

        $extension = strtolower(pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        $allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'html', 'xhtml'];
        if (!in_array($extension, $allowedExtensions, true)) {
            return 'Invalid file extension';
        }

        if (strlen($content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
            return 'File too large';
        }

        if (!$this->validateContentSignature($content, $extension)) {
            return 'Content does not match declared type';
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function validateContentSignature(string $content, string $extension): bool
    {
        return match ($extension) {
            'pdf' => str_starts_with($content, '%PDF'),
            'html', 'xhtml' => (bool)preg_match('/^\s*(<\?xml|<!DOCTYPE|<html)/i', $content),
            default => false,
        };
    }

    private function buildSafeFilename(string $filename): string
    {
        $info = pathinfo($filename);
        $basename = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '', $info['filename']);
        $extension = preg_replace('/[^a-z]/', '', strtolower($info['extension'] ?? ''));
        return $basename . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $extension;
    }

    private function persistTemplate(string $destination, string $content, string $originalFilename): array
    {
        $written = file_put_contents($destination, $content);
        if ($written === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to write template');
        }

        $this->registerTemplateMetadata($destination, $originalFilename);
        return ['success' => true, 'path' => $destination, 'size' => $written];
    }

    private function registerTemplateMetadata(string $path, string $originalName): void
    {
        $metaFile = $path . '.meta';
        $metadata = json_encode([
            'original_name' => $originalName,
            'uploaded_at' => time(),
            'checksum' => hash_file('sha256', $path),
        ]);
        file_put_contents($metaFile, $metadata);
    }

    private function executeWithRetry(callable $operation): array
    {
        $attempts = 0;
        $lastException = null;

        while ($attempts < $this->maxRetries) {
            try {
                return $operation();
            } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
                $lastException = $e;
                $attempts++;
                $this->retryState[] = ['attempt' => $attempts, 'time' => microtime(true)];
                usleep(min(100000 * pow(2, $attempts), 2000000));
            }
        }

        return ['error' => 'Operation failed after retries', 'details' => $lastException?->getMessage()];
    }

    private function renderPdf(string $templatePath, array $data, string $format): array
    {
        $content = file_get_contents($templatePath);
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                $content = str_replace('{{' . $key . '}}', htmlspecialchars($value, ENT_QUOTES), $content);
            }
        }

        $outputPath = $this->fileManager->allocate('output_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $format);
        file_put_contents($outputPath, $content);
        return ['success' => true, 'output' => $outputPath];
    }
}

class TokenBucket
{
    private int $capacity;
    private int $windowSeconds;
    private array $tokens = [];

    public function __construct(int $capacity, int $windowSeconds)
    {
        $this->capacity = $capacity;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }

    public function consume(): bool
    {
        $now = time();
        $this->tokens = array_filter($this->tokens, fn($t) => $t > $now - $this->windowSeconds);
        if (count($this->tokens) >= $this->capacity) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->tokens[] = $now;
        return true;
    }

    public function getRetryAfter(): int
    {
        return $this->windowSeconds - (time() - min($this->tokens));
    }
}

class TempFileManager
{
    private string $baseDir;

    public function __construct(string $baseDir)
    {
        $this->baseDir = rtrim($baseDir, '/');
        if (!is_dir($this->baseDir)) {
            mkdir($this->baseDir, 0750, true);
        }
    }

    public function allocate(string $filename): string
    {
        return $this->baseDir . '/' . $filename;
    }
}
